title: I built an AI Agent that triages inbound pitch decks against a fund thesis
author: Emmai001
selftext:
Here's how it works: A deck comes in, the agent reads it and scores it against the fund's written thesis. It also checks PostgreSQL (memory) for past deals and drops only the ones worth reviewing into Slack with a short brief. I attached the Loom video walkthrough and where to get the agent JSON in case you need it. 

I also have a portfolio monitoring agent there that you can check out.

\[https://www.loom.com/share/ceb4a4f5470c4cbc83c9d9784f9c1ec0\](https://www.loom.com/share/ceb4a4f5470c4cbc83c9d9784f9c1ec0)

comments.author: Otherwise_Wave9374
comments.body: A useful next step is to separate thesis fit from operational signal so the scoring remains explainable. For example, keep one pass that extracts fund-stage, sector, and check size, then a second pass that flags missing diligence items or unusual claims, and only then route a compact brief to Slack. That makes false positives easier to audit and lets you tune thresholds without retraining the whole flow. Agentix Labs could fit well here if you want a lightweight pattern for chaining those checks into a review queue.

comments.author: Drakula106
comments.body: Why is this any better than a well put together prompt sent to Astra/Fable? I feel like this could be a template, why's it gotta be an "AI Agent"?

replies.author: Emmai001
replies.body: You can add a lot other complexities like adding custom code, it automatically monitors your Gmail for any new deck mail, you can add a lot more tools that take actions. The goal is having something highly customized to how you want it, you can also switch models.
